adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in the delete action at line 46, `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` only has a success handler but no `.catch()` or rejection handler. If the DELETE request fails due to network error or server error, the promise rejection will be unhandled, and the user will see no error message while the row remains visible. This is a real defect - other actions in the same file like `save()` properly use `.catch(popupAjaxError)` to handle errors, but the delete action does not.
